title: Late Charges After the Final Bill, Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
A charge found after the final bill of a Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account is a late charge.

**Clause.** A late charge posts and is billed only when it posts within the class's late-charge window, in calendar days after the final bill date. On an insured account it is billed by replacement claim; on a self-pay account it adds to the self-pay liability with the uninsured discount. A late charge that posts after the window is credited in full as a late charge past window and is never billed to the patient or the payer.

| Late charge posts | Insured account | Self-pay account |
|---|---|---|
| within the window | billed by replacement claim | added to the self-pay liability with the uninsured discount |
| after the window | credited in full; never billed | credited in full; never billed |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, a window of 7 days).* With a final bill date of 10 April, a late charge posting on 17 April is within the window and billed; one posting on 18 April is credited in full and never billed.
